title: Actions upon successful completion of a random-access procedure or on successful or unsuccessful completion of a procedure for request of on- demand system information

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that performs random-access procedures and maintains RA report information.

entities.name: VarRA-Report
entities.description: UE variable storing random access report information including RA-Report entries and PLMN identity lists.

entities.name: RA-Report Entry
entities.description: An entry in the RA report containing PLMN identities, cell identifiers, and RA purpose information.

entities.name: plmn-IdentityList
entities.description: List of PLMN identities stored in VarRA-Report, used for tracking PLMNs associated with RA procedures.

entities.name: Registered PLMN
entities.description: The PLMN where the UE is currently registered.

entities.name: Equivalent PLMN
entities.description: List of PLMNs equivalent to the RPLMN for network selection purposes.

entities.name: cellId
entities.description: Cell identifier information including global cell identity, tracking area code, or physical cell identity.

entities.name: spCellId
entities.description: Special cell identifier for PCell or PSCell depending on where RA procedure was performed.

entities.name: raPurpose
entities.description: Purpose of triggering the random-access procedure.

entities.name: ra-InformationCommon
entities.description: Common RA information as specified in clause 5.7.10.5.

entities.name: RPLMN not in plmn-IdentityList
entities.description: Condition where the RPLMN or selected PLMN is not included in the stored plmn-IdentityList.

entities.name: RA-Report entries less than maxRAReport
entities.description: Condition where number of RA-Report entries is below the maximum limit.

entities.name: PLMN entries less than maxPLMN
entities.description: Condition where number of PLMN entries is below the maximum limit.

relations.description: UE maintains and updates VarRA-Report variable based on RA procedure outcomes.
When RPLMN is not in stored plmn-IdentityList, UE clears VarRA-Report information.
When RA-Report entries are below maximum, UE can append new RA report entries.
When PLMN entries are below maximum, UE can update plmn-IdentityList.
RA report entry contains PLMN identity list information.
RA report entry contains cell identifier information.
RA report entry contains special cell identifier for PCell/PSCell.
RA report entry contains the purpose of the random-access procedure.
RA report entry contains common RA information as specified in clause 5.7.10.5.
PLMN identity list may include equivalent PLMNs when available.
